verdicts.reason: Both reverse the reading order: the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow now sits below the headline and is shrunk until you can't read it. In both, 'Small-Batch' runs almost into the canvas edges, and the legal text is nearly as large as the body copy. In A the header band is squashed thin, the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and the sun mark is almost gone, and the orange rule has floated up under the header. B keeps a taller header with a visible sun icon, so the brand survives a bit better, but its orange rule ends up stranded at the very bottom under the legal text and the wordmark is still tiny.
